  justify-content: center;
  padding: 6vh 16px 40px;
}
.auth-card {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 380px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}
.auth-card h1 {
  font-size: var(--fs-2xl);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.022em;
  margin: 0;
  text-align: center;
}
.auth-card .sub {
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--text-2);
  margin: -8px 0 4px;
}
.or {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  color: var(--text-3);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
}
.or::before,
.or::after {
  content: '';
  flex: 1;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--border);
}
.social {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.social .btn {
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.glyph-g,
.glyph-m,
.glyph-a {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.link {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 500;
}
.link:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.auth-foot {
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
}
.strength {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
}
.strength i {
  flex: 1;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--surface-3);
}
.strength i.on {
  background: var(--c);
}
.onb {
  max-width: 560px;
}
.steps {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.steps i {
  width: 28px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--border-strong);
  transition: background 0.2s;
}
.steps i.on {
  background: var(--accent);
}
.opts {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}
.opt {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 14px 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  text-align: left;
  background: var(--surface);
  transition:
    border-color var(--dur),
    box-shadow var(--dur),
    background var(--dur);
}
.opt:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}
.opt.on {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft);
}
.opt .i {
  color: var(--text-2);
}
.opt.on .i {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.opt b {
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: var(--fs);
}
.opt span {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-3);
}
.tmpls {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}
.iconpick {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr);
  gap: 4px;
}
.iconpick button {
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: var(--text-2);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.iconpick button:hover {
  background: var(--surface-2);
}
.iconpick button.on {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-soft);
}

/* design system page */
.ds-sec {
  margin-top: 36px;
}
.ds-sec > h2 {
  font-size: var(--fs-md);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 10px;
}
.ds-sec > h2 span {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-3);
  font-weight: 400;
}
.ds-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
}
.ds-tok {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r);
  overflow: hidden;
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
}
.ds-tok .c {
  height: 44px;
  background: var(--c);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.ds-tok .n {
  padding: 6px 8px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.ds-tok .n code {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-3);
}
.ds-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.ds-row .lab {
  width: 90px;
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);

/* ============================================================
   MOTION: one-shot flow animations (gated to the render they belong to)
   ============================================================ */
@keyframes riseIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes slideInR {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(18px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes growX {
  from {
    transform: scaleX(0);
  }
}
@keyframes popCheck {
  0% {
    transform: scale(0.55);
  }
  55% {
    transform: scale(1.2);
  }
  100% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}
@keyframes strike {
  to {
    background-size: 100% 1.5px;
  }
}
@keyframes doneWash {
  from {
    background: var(--green-soft);
  }
  to {
    background: transparent;
  }
}
@keyframes doneRing {
  from {
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 2px var(--green),
      var(--shadow-card);
  }
  to {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}
@keyframes land {
  0% {
    transform: scale(1.04) rotate(-1.2deg);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-drag);
  }
  100% {
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}
@keyframes addWash {
  from {
    background: var(--accent-soft);
  }
  to {
    background: transparent;
  }
}
@keyframes addRing {
  from {
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 2px var(--accent-line),
      var(--shadow-card);
  }
  to {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}
/* route change: content rises in, lightly staggered */
.fx-route > .page > *,
.fx-route > .fullstate {
  animation: riseIn 0.36s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route > .page > *:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.035s;
}
.fx-route > .page > *:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.07s;
}
.fx-route > .page > *:nth-child(n + 4) {
  animation-delay: 0.1s;
}
.fx-route .grid2 > * > *:nth-child(2),
.fx-route .grid2 > *:nth-child(2) > *:first-child {
  animation: riseIn 0.4s 0.09s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route .prog > i {
  animation: growX 0.8s 0.12s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route .stackbar i {
  transform-origin: left;
  animation: growX 0.8s 0.12s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route .bar {
  animation: riseIn 0.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.pbody {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.pbody.fx-tab > * {
  animation: riseIn 0.26s var(--ease) both;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .kcard {
  animation: riseIn 0.32s var(--ease) both;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .bcol:nth-child(2) .kcard {
  animation-delay: 0.03s;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .bcol:nth-child(3) .kcard {
  animation-delay: 0.06s;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .bcol:nth-child(n + 4) .kcard {
  animation-delay: 0.09s;
}
/* task completed */
.trow.fx-done,
.mini.fx-done {
  animation: doneWash 1s var(--ease) both;
}
.kcard.fx-done {
  animation: doneRing 1s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-done .check,
.fx-done .done-ic {
  animation: popCheck 0.42s var(--spring) both;
}
.fx-done .tt,
.fx-done .title {
  text-decoration: none !important;
  background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) 0 58%/0 1.5px no-repeat;
  animation: strike 0.38s 0.1s var(--ease) forwards;
}
/* dropped, created */
.kcard.fx-moved {
  animation: land 0.5s var(--spring) both;
}
.cev.fx-moved,
.wcard.fx-moved {
  animation: popCheck 0.4s var(--spring) both;
}
.trow.fx-added,
.mini.fx-added {
  animation:
    riseIn 0.3s var(--ease) both,
    addWash 1.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.kcard.fx-added {
  animation:
    riseIn 0.3s var(--ease) both,
    addRing 1.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.subt.fx-added {
  animation: riseIn 0.28s var(--ease) both;
}
/* auth + onboarding */
.auth-card.fx-auth > * {
  animation: riseIn 0.42s var(--ease) both;
}
.auth-card.fx-auth > *:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.04s;
}
.auth-card.fx-auth > *:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.08s;
}
.auth-card.fx-auth > *:nth-child(n + 4) {
  animation-delay: 0.12s;
}
.onb.fx-step > *:not(.steps) {
  animation: slideInR 0.36s var(--ease) both;
}
.onb.fx-step > *:nth-child(n + 4) {
  animation-delay: 0.05s;
}
.steps i {
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: background 0.3s;
}
.onb.fx-step .steps i.cur {
  animation: growX 0.45s var(--ease) both;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row {
  animation: riseIn 0.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.12s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.24s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row .ok {
  animation: popCheck 0.42s var(--spring) both;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(1) .ok {
  animation-delay: 0.18s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(2) .ok {
  animation-delay: 0.3s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(3) .ok {
  animation-delay: 0.42s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-badge {
  animation: popCheck 0.5s 0.05s var(--spring) both;
}
/* tactile micro-feedback */
.check:active {
  transform: scale(0.88);
}
.check {
  transition:
    background var(--dur),
    border-color var(--dur),
    transform 0.12s var(--ease);
}
.toggle::after {
  transition: transform 0.28s var(--spring);
}
.pcard {
  transition:
    border-color var(--dur),
    box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease),
    transform 0.2s var(--ease);
}
.pcard:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.kcard {
  transition:
    box-shadow var(--dur),
    transform 0.18s var(--ease);
}
.kcard:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.stat .v {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

<html lang="en" data-theme="light" data-side="comfortable" data-density="comfortable"><head>
    <script type="module" src="/@vite/client"></script>

    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
    <title>Overview · Gr8r Studio</title>
    <meta name="description" content="Gr8r Studio — a calm, structured project management workspace.">
    <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/favicon.svg">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin="">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Geist:wght@400;500;600&family=Geist+Mono:wght@400&display=swap" media="all" data-font="">
  <style type="text/css" data-vite-dev-id="/workspace/task8/.reference/gr8r-studio/src/styles/index.css">/* Load order matters: tokens first, responsive and motion overrides last. */
/* ============================================================
   QUIRE — DESIGN TOKENS
   Light palette on bare :root; dark redefined (not inverted).
   ============================================================ */
:root {
  /* surfaces */
  --bg: #fbfaf8;
  --bg-side: #f4f3f0;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --surface-2: #f6f5f2;
  --surface-3: #eeede9;
  --sunken: #f7f6f3;
  --overlay: rgba(24, 22, 19, 0.28);
  /* lines */
  --border: #e9e7e2;
  --border-strong: #dad7d0;
  --divider: #f0eeea;
  /* text */
  --text: #1d1c1a;
  --text-2: #57544e;
  --text-3: #6b6760;
  --text-4: #8c8880;
  --text-inv: #ffffff;
  /* accent (swappable) */
  --acc-l: #4b5bd6;
  --acc-d: #8e9af3;
  --accent: var(--acc-l);
  --on-accent: #ffffff;
  --accent-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent);
  --accent-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 38%, transparent);
  /* semantic */
  --green: #25754b;
  --amber: #8f5e0e;
  --red: #b23c30;
  --blue: #3570c4;
  --violet: #7652c2;
  --teal: #1e8580;
  --rose: #bc4270;
  --orange: #c0612b;
  --gray: #8a867e;
  --green-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--green) 11%, transparent);
  --amber-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 12%, transparent);
  --red-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--red) 10%, transparent);
  /* status */
  --st-backlog: #a29e96;
  --st-todo: #7c7870;
  --st-progress: #c88a14;
  --st-review: #7652c2;
  --st-done: #2e8456;
  /* elevation */
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(28, 25, 20, 0.05);
  --shadow-card: 0 1px 2px rgba(28, 25, 20, 0.04), 0 0 0 1px var(--border);
  --shadow-pop: 0 12px 32px -8px rgba(28, 25, 20, 0.16), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(28, 25, 20, 0.06), 0 0 0 1px var(--border);
  --shadow-drag: 0 16px 36px -10px rgba(28, 25, 20, 0.28), 0 0 0 1px var(--border-strong);
  /* radius */
  --r-xs: 4px;
  --r-sm: 6px;
  --r: 8px;
  --r-lg: 10px;
  --r-full: 999px;
  /* spacing (4pt scale) */
  --s-1: 4px;
  --s-2: 8px;
  --s-3: 12px;
  --s-4: 16px;
  --s-5: 20px;
  --s-6: 24px;
  --s-8: 32px;
  --s-10: 40px;
  --s-12: 48px;
  /* type */
  --font: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
  --mono: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  --fs-2xs: 11px;
  --fs-xs: 12px;
  --fs-sm: 12.5px;
  --fs: 13.5px;
  --fs-md: 14.5px;
  --fs-lg: 16px;
  --fs-xl: 19px;
  --fs-2xl: 23px;
  /* component sizes */
  --h-xs: 22px;
  --h-sm: 26px;
  --h-md: 30px;
  --h-lg: 36px;
  --side-w: 252px;
  --side-row: 30px;
  --row-h: 40px;
  --card-pad: 10px;
  --topbar-h: 46px;
  /* one horizontal content edge shared by breadcrumb, page headers, toolbars, lists, tables and boards */
  --gutter: 24px;
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  --spring: cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
  --ease-drawer: cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
  --dur: 140ms;
  color-scheme: light;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-theme='light']) {
    --bg: #1a1a19;
    --bg-side: #151514;
    --surface: #1d1d1c;
    --surface-2: #252524;
    --surface-3: #2d2d2b;
    --sunken: #181817;
    --overlay: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
    --border: #2c2b29;
    --border-strong: #3a3936;
    --divider: #252523;
    --text: #eceae5;
    --text-2: #b5b2ab;
    --text-3: #9a968f;
    --text-4: #6f6c66;
    --text-inv: #151514;
    --accent: var(--acc-d);
    --on-accent: #12131c;
    --green: #5cba86;
    --amber: #d8a443;
    --red: #e57d70;
    --blue: #72a5ea;
    --violet: #a98deb;
    --teal: #58c0b6;
    --rose: #e68aab;
    --orange: #e3925f;
    --gray: #8f8b84;
    --pc-mix: 72%;

    --st-progress: #d8a443;
    --st-review: #a98deb;
    --st-done: #5cba86;
    --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    --shadow-card: 0 0 0 1px var(--border);
    --shadow-pop: 0 16px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 0 1px var(--border-strong);
    --shadow-drag: 0 18px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 0 1px var(--border-strong);
    color-scheme: dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme='dark'] {
  --bg: #1a1a19;
