.frow .input {
  height: var(--h-sm);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
}
.valbtn {
  height: var(--h-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  padding: 0 8px;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  text-align: left;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: var(--surface);
}
.valbtn:hover {
  background: var(--surface-2);
}

.palette {
  position: fixed;
  top: 12vh;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: min(640px, calc(100vw - 32px));
  background: var(--surface);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  z-index: 90;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 70vh;
}
.pal-in {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  height: 50px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.pal-in input {
  flex: 1;
  border: 0;
  outline: 0;
  background: transparent;
  font-size: var(--fs-md);
  height: 100%;
}
.pal-scope {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.pal-scope button {
  height: 24px;
  padding: 0 9px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-2);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 5px;
}
.pal-scope button.on {
  background: var(--text);
  color: var(--text-inv);
  border-color: var(--text);
}
.pal-list {
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 6px;
  flex: 1;
}
.pal-sec {
  font-size: var(--fs-2xs);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-3);
  padding: 10px 10px 4px;
}
.pal-sec + .pi {
  margin-top: 0;
}
.pal-group {
  padding-bottom: 4px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.pal-group:last-child {
  border-bottom: 0;
}
.pi {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  height: 38px;
  padding: 0 10px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  width: 100%;
  text-align: left;
  font-size: var(--fs);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.pi.hl {
  background: var(--surface-2);
}
.pi .i {
  color: var(--text-2);
}
.pi .sub {
  color: var(--text-3);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  margin-left: 4px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.pi .r {
  margin-left: auto;
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  align-items: center;
  color: var(--text-3);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
}
.pi mark {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 600;
}
.pal-f {
  display: flex;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-3);
  background: var(--sunken);
}
.pal-f span {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: 5px;
  align-items: center;
}

#toasts {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 20px;
  right: 20px;
  z-index: 100;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: flex-end;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.toast {
  pointer-events: auto;
  animation-timing-function: var(--spring) !important;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 40px;
  padding: 8px 8px 8px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--r);
  background: var(--text);
  color: var(--text-inv);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  animation: toastIn 0.2s var(--ease) both;
  max-width: 400px;
}
.toast.out {
  animation: toastOut 0.16s ease both;
}
.toast .i.ok {
  color: var(--green);
}
.toast .i.bad {
  color: var(--red);
}
.toast .ta {
  color: var(--text-inv);
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  opacity: 0.9;
}
.toast .ta:hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-inv) 14%, transparent);
}
@keyframes toastIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(14px) scale(0.96);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes toastOut {
  to {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(4px);
  }
}
/* ============================================================
   STATES: EMPTY / SKELETON / ERROR
   ============================================================ */
.empty-state {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 56px 24px;
  gap: 6px;
}
.empty-state .glyph {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: var(--text-4);
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.empty-state .glyph svg {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
}
.empty-state .es-h {
  font-size: var(--fs-md);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 0;
}
.empty-state p {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  margin: 0 0 10px;
  max-width: 340px;
}
.empty-state.sm {
  padding: 28px 16px;
}
.empty-state.err .glyph {
  color: var(--red);
}
.sk {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--surface-3) 0%, var(--surface-2) 45%, var(--surface-3) 90%);
  background-size: 220% 100%;
  animation: shimmer 1.3s ease-in-out infinite;
  border-radius: 5px;
  display: block;
}
@keyframes shimmer {
  from {
    background-position: 120% 0;
  }
  to {
    background-position: -100% 0;
  }
}
.alert {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--r);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  align-items: flex-start;
  background: var(--surface);
}
.alert .i {
  margin-top: 1px;
}
.alert.warn {
  background: var(--amber-soft);
  border-color: transparent;
}
.alert.warn .i {
  color: var(--amber);
}
.alert.danger {
  background: var(--red-soft);
  border-color: transparent;
}
.alert.danger .i {
  color: var(--red);
}
.alert.info {
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  border-color: transparent;
}
.alert.info .i {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.alert.ok {
  background: var(--green-soft);
  border-color: transparent;
}
.alert.ok .i {
  color: var(--green);
}
.alert b {
  font-weight: 600;
}
.fullstate {
  min-height: 100%;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 40px 20px;
}
.fullstate .box {
  max-width: 420px;
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
}
.fullstate .code {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-3);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}
.fullstate h1 {
  font-size: var(--fs-xl);
  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
}
.fullstate p {
  color: var(--text-2);
  margin: 0 0 12px;
}
/* ============================================================
   SETTINGS
   ============================================================ */
.set {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr);
  height: 100%;
}
.set-nav {
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 20px 10px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--surface);
}
.set-nav .gh {
  font-size: var(--fs-2xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--text-3);
  padding: 14px 8px 4px;
}
.set-nav .gh:first-child {
  padding-top: 0;
}
.set-body {
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.set-in {
  max-width: 720px;
  padding: 32px 40px 80px;
}
.set-in h1 {
  font-size: var(--fs-xl);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  letter-spacing: -0.015em;
}
.set-in > p.lead {
  color: var(--text-2);
  margin: 0 0 24px;
}
.srow {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  gap: 24px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 14px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider);
}
.srow .t {
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: var(--fs);
}
.srow .d {
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.sblock {
  margin-top: 28px;
}
.sblock > h2 {
  font-size: var(--fs);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 0 0 4px;
  padding-bottom: 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.themecards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}
.tcard {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 8px;
  text-align: left;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  transition:
    border-color var(--dur),
    box-shadow var(--dur);
}
.tcard:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}
.tcard.on {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft);
}
.tprev {
  height: 84px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 30% 1fr;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(128, 128, 128, 0.2);
}
.tprev .s {
  padding: 8px 6px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}
.tprev .m {
  padding: 10px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
}
.tprev i {
  display: block;
  height: 5px;
  border-radius: 3px;
}
.swatches {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.sw {
  width: 26px;
  height: 26px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--c);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  transition: transform var(--dur);
}
.sw:hover {
  transform: scale(1.08);
}
.sw.on {
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 2px var(--surface),
    0 0 0 4px var(--c);
}
.perm-t {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
}
.perm-t th,
.perm-t td {
  padding: 9px 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--divider);
  text-align: center;
}
.perm-t th:first-child,
.perm-t td:first-child {
  text-align: left;
}
.perm-t th {
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
}
.plan {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 16px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.plan.cur {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft);
}
.plan .pr {
  font-size: var(--fs-xl);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}
.plan ul {
  margin: 4px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 5px;
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
  color: var(--text-2);
}
.plan li {
  display: flex;
  gap: 7px;
  align-items: center;
}
.plan li .i {
  color: var(--green);
}
.meter {
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--surface-3);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.meter i {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--accent);
}
/* ============================================================
   AUTH / ONBOARDING
   ============================================================ */
.auth {
  min-height: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--bg);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.auth-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 18px 24px;
}
.brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-size: var(--fs-md);
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}
.auth-c {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 6vh 16px 40px;
}
.auth-card {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 380px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 16px;
}
.auth-card h1 {
  font-size: var(--fs-2xl);
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.022em;
  margin: 0;
  text-align: center;
}
.auth-card .sub {
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--text-2);
  margin: -8px 0 4px;
}
.or {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  color: var(--text-3);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
}
.or::before,
.or::after {
  content: '';
  flex: 1;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--border);
}
.social {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
}
.social .btn {
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.glyph-g,
.glyph-m,
.glyph-a {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  display: inline-grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 13px;
}
.link {
  color: var(--accent);
  font-weight: 500;
}
.link:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.auth-foot {
  text-align: center;
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-size: var(--fs-sm);
}
.strength {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
}
.strength i {
  flex: 1;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--surface-3);
}
.strength i.on {
  background: var(--c);
}
.onb {
  max-width: 560px;
}
.steps {
  display: flex;
  gap: 6px;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.steps i {
  width: 28px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--border-strong);
  transition: background 0.2s;
}
.steps i.on {
  background: var(--accent);
}
.opts {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}
.opt {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r-lg);
  padding: 14px 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 8px;
  text-align: left;
  background: var(--surface);
  transition:
    border-color var(--dur),
    box-shadow var(--dur),
    background var(--dur);
}
.opt:hover {
  border-color: var(--border-strong);
}
.opt.on {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft);
}
.opt .i {
  color: var(--text-2);
}
.opt.on .i {
  color: var(--accent);
}
.opt b {
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: var(--fs);
}
.opt span {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-3);
}
.tmpls {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 8px;
}
.iconpick {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr);
  gap: 4px;
}
.iconpick button {
  height: 32px;
  border-radius: var(--r-sm);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: var(--text-2);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.iconpick button:hover {
  background: var(--surface-2);
}
.iconpick button.on {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  background: var(--accent-soft);
}

/* design system page */
.ds-sec {
  margin-top: 36px;
}
.ds-sec > h2 {
  font-size: var(--fs-md);
  font-weight: 600;
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 10px;
}
.ds-sec > h2 span {
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-3);
  font-weight: 400;
}
.ds-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr));
  gap: 10px;
}
.ds-tok {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r);
  overflow: hidden;
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
}
.ds-tok .c {
  height: 44px;
  background: var(--c);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.ds-tok .n {
  padding: 6px 8px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.ds-tok .n code {
  font-family: var(--mono);
  font-size: 11px;
  color: var(--text-3);
}
.ds-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 12px;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--r);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.ds-row .lab {
  width: 90px;
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-3);
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.state-hover {
  background: var(--surface-2) !important;
}
.btn-primary.state-hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 88%, var(--text)) !important;
}
.btn-primary.state-active {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 78%, var(--text)) !important;
}
.state-focus {
  outline: 2px solid var(--accent) !important;
  outline-offset: 1px;
}
.states-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}
.states-grid .panel {
  overflow: hidden;
}
.states-grid .cap {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: var(--fs-xs);
  color: var(--text-2);
  font-weight: 500;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  background: var(--sunken);
}
/* ============================================================
   MOTION: one-shot flow animations (gated to the render they belong to)
   ============================================================ */
@keyframes riseIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes slideInR {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(18px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@keyframes growX {
  from {
    transform: scaleX(0);
  }
}
@keyframes popCheck {
  0% {
    transform: scale(0.55);
  }
  55% {
    transform: scale(1.2);
  }
  100% {
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}
@keyframes strike {
  to {
    background-size: 100% 1.5px;
  }
}
@keyframes doneWash {
  from {
    background: var(--green-soft);
  }
  to {
    background: transparent;
  }
}
@keyframes doneRing {
  from {
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 2px var(--green),
      var(--shadow-card);
  }
  to {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}
@keyframes land {
  0% {
    transform: scale(1.04) rotate(-1.2deg);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-drag);
  }
  100% {
    transform: none;
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}
@keyframes addWash {
  from {
    background: var(--accent-soft);
  }
  to {
    background: transparent;
  }
}
@keyframes addRing {
  from {
    box-shadow:
      0 0 0 2px var(--accent-line),
      var(--shadow-card);
  }
  to {
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  }
}
/* route change: content rises in, lightly staggered */
.fx-route > .page > *,
.fx-route > .fullstate {
  animation: riseIn 0.36s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route > .page > *:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.035s;
}
.fx-route > .page > *:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.07s;
}
.fx-route > .page > *:nth-child(n + 4) {
  animation-delay: 0.1s;
}
.fx-route .grid2 > * > *:nth-child(2),
.fx-route .grid2 > *:nth-child(2) > *:first-child {
  animation: riseIn 0.4s 0.09s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route .prog > i {
  animation: growX 0.8s 0.12s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route .stackbar i {
  transform-origin: left;
  animation: growX 0.8s 0.12s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-route .bar {
  animation: riseIn 0.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.pbody {
  flex: 1;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}
.pbody.fx-tab > * {
  animation: riseIn 0.26s var(--ease) both;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .kcard {
  animation: riseIn 0.32s var(--ease) both;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .bcol:nth-child(2) .kcard {
  animation-delay: 0.03s;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .bcol:nth-child(3) .kcard {
  animation-delay: 0.06s;
}
.pbody.fx-tab .bcol:nth-child(n + 4) .kcard {
  animation-delay: 0.09s;
}
/* task completed */
.trow.fx-done,
.mini.fx-done {
  animation: doneWash 1s var(--ease) both;
}
.kcard.fx-done {
  animation: doneRing 1s var(--ease) both;
}
.fx-done .check,
.fx-done .done-ic {
  animation: popCheck 0.42s var(--spring) both;
}
.fx-done .tt,
.fx-done .title {
  text-decoration: none !important;
  background: linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor) 0 58%/0 1.5px no-repeat;
  animation: strike 0.38s 0.1s var(--ease) forwards;
}
/* dropped, created */
.kcard.fx-moved {
  animation: land 0.5s var(--spring) both;
}
.cev.fx-moved,
.wcard.fx-moved {
  animation: popCheck 0.4s var(--spring) both;
}
.trow.fx-added,
.mini.fx-added {
  animation:
    riseIn 0.3s var(--ease) both,
    addWash 1.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.kcard.fx-added {
  animation:
    riseIn 0.3s var(--ease) both,
    addRing 1.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.subt.fx-added {
  animation: riseIn 0.28s var(--ease) both;
}
/* auth + onboarding */
.auth-card.fx-auth > * {
  animation: riseIn 0.42s var(--ease) both;
}
.auth-card.fx-auth > *:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.04s;
}
.auth-card.fx-auth > *:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.08s;
}
.auth-card.fx-auth > *:nth-child(n + 4) {
  animation-delay: 0.12s;
}
.onb.fx-step > *:not(.steps) {
  animation: slideInR 0.36s var(--ease) both;
}
.onb.fx-step > *:nth-child(n + 4) {
  animation-delay: 0.05s;
}
.steps i {
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: background 0.3s;
}
.onb.fx-step .steps i.cur {
  animation: growX 0.45s var(--ease) both;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row {
  animation: riseIn 0.4s var(--ease) both;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(2) {
  animation-delay: 0.12s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(3) {
  animation-delay: 0.24s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row .ok {
  animation: popCheck 0.42s var(--spring) both;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(1) .ok {
  animation-delay: 0.18s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(2) .ok {
  animation-delay: 0.3s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-row:nth-child(3) .ok {
  animation-delay: 0.42s;
}
.onb.fx-step .ready-badge {
  animation: popCheck 0.5s 0.05s var(--spring) both;
}
/* tactile micro-feedback */
.check:active {
  transform: scale(0.88);
}
.check {
  transition:
    background var(--dur),
    border-color var(--dur),
    transform 0.12s var(--ease);
}
.toggle::after {
  transition: transform 0.28s var(--spring);
}
.pcard {
  transition:
    border-color var(--dur),
    box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease),
    transform 0.2s var(--ease);
}
.pcard:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.kcard {
  transition:
    box-shadow var(--dur),
    transform 0.18s var(--ease);
}
.kcard:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.stat .v {
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .fx-route > .page > *,
  .fx-route > .fullstate,
  .fx-route .grid2 > * > *,
  .fx-route .bar,
  .pbody.fx-tab > *,
  .pbody.fx-tab .kcard,
  .auth-card.fx-auth > *,
  .onb.fx-step > *,
  .drawer.enter .drawer-b > *,
  .kcard.fx-moved,
  .cev.fx-moved,
  .wcard.fx-moved,
  .fx-done .check,
  .onb.fx-step .ready-row,
  .onb.fx-step .ready-row .ok,
  .onb.fx-step .ready-badge {
    animation: fadeOnly 0.12s both !important;
  }
  .fx-route .prog > i,
  .fx-route .stackbar i,
  .onb.fx-step .steps i.cur {
    animation: none !important;
  }
  .fx-done .tt,
  .fx-done .title {
    animation: none;
    background: none;
    text-decoration: line-through !important;
  }
  .pcard:hover,
  .kcard:hover,
  .check:active {
    transform: none;
  }
}
:root[data-motion='reduce'] .fx-route > .page > *,
:root[data-motion='reduce'] .pbody.fx-tab > *,
:root[data-motion='reduce'] .auth-card.fx-auth > *,
:root[data-motion='reduce'] .onb.fx-step > *,
:root[data-motion='reduce'] .drawer.enter .drawer-b > *,
:root[data-motion='reduce'] .kcard.fx-moved {
  animation: fadeOnly 0.12s both !important;
}
:root[data-motion='reduce'] .fx-route .prog > i,
:root[data-motion='reduce'] .fx-route .stackbar i {
  animation: none !important;
}
:root[data-motion='reduce'] .pcard:hover,
:root[data-motion='reduce'] .kcard:hover {
  transform: none;
}
/* ============================================================
   RESPONSIVE
   ============================================================ */
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .grid2 {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .topsearch {
    width: auto;
  }
  .topsearch .lbltxt,
  .topsearch .kbd {
    display: none;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .shell,
  .shell.collapsed {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .side {
    position: fixed;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 280px;
    z-index: 70;
    transform: translateX(-100%);
    transition: transform 0.22s var(--ease);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
  }
  .shell.mnav .side {
    transform: none;
  }
  .shell.collapsed .side .sitem {
    justify-content: flex-start;
    padding: 0 8px;
  }
  .side-scrim {
    display: block;
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    background: var(--overlay);
    z-index: 69;
    animation: fade 0.14s both;
  }
  :root {
    --gutter: 16px;
  }
  .page {
    padding: 20px var(--gutter) 96px;
  }
  .stats {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .stat:nth-child(3) {
    border-left: 0;
  }
  .stat:nth-child(n + 3) {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .set {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);

@media (max-width: 640px) {

    position: fixed;

    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;

  .ph .acts {

  .list-wrap {

  }
  .tlist .thead {
    display: none;
  }
  .tlist .trow {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px 6px;
    padding: 10px 6px;

    border-radius: var(--r);

  .tlist .trow > div {
    padding: 0;
  }
  .tlist .trow .handle {
    display: none;
  }

    order: 0;

    display: none;
  }
  .drawer,
  .drawer.full {

    left: 0;

    bottom: 0;
    transform: none;
    border-radius: 0;
    border: 0;
  }
  .drawer-b,
  .drawer.full .drawer-b {
    padding: 16px 16px 40px;
  }
  .modal-wrap {
    padding: 0;
    align-items: flex-end;
  }
  .modal {
    max-height: 92vh;
    border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0;
  }
  .opts,
  .tmpls {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .themecards {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .fbuild {
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .frow {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }
  .frow .conj {
    display: none;
  }
  .cal-g {
    grid-auto-rows: minmax(72px, 1fr);
  }
  .cev .trunc,
  .cev .av {
    display: none;
  }
  .cev {
    height: 8px;
    padding: 0;
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: var(--c);
  }
  .week {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    overflow-y: auto;
  }
  .wcol {
    border-right: 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .tl-left {
    display: none;
  }
  .tl {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  #toasts {
    left: 16px;
    right: 16px;
    bottom: 76px;
    align-items: stretch;
  }
  .kv {
    grid-template-columns: 96px minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .srow {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .topsearch {
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    padding: 0;
    width: var(--h-md);
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .crumbs button:not(.cur),
  .crumbs .sep {
    display: none;
  }
  .crumbs .cur {
    display: block;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  .crumbs .cur > span {
    display: none !important;
  }
  .panel-h {
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .panel-h h2 {
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .topbar .ibtn,
  .topbar .btn,
  .topsearch {
    min-width: 40px;
    min-height: 40px;
  }
  .palette {
    top: 8px;

    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
    <title>Tasks · Gr8r Studio</title>
    <meta name="description" content="Gr8r Studio — a calm, structured project management workspace.">
